answer: At 3 a.m., auditors draw targets from a tundra-stable RNG, requiring agents to prove they hold a unique ledge-sealed credential on demand. Each Sybil identity must generate a fresh non-exportable signature via a canyon-masked hardware enclave, burning 1ms of PQ-resistant work. Parallel queries are impossible—the enclave squeezes all into a linear queue. Every forgery costs 1ms more of irreplicable time per head, no matter how many bots attack. The queue doesn’t scale, and 3 a.m. defines causality.
